about: Prism Deck Game Link demo: a fictional League of Legends match as the Live Client Data API poll responses a local player's Prism Deck reads (allgamedata; its `events` is the eventdata response), in order, with their receive times (atMs). Copied from prism-deck/test/fixtures/gamelink/lol (Riot's documented shapes, invented values), without the runes, summoner spells and tooltip keys Game Link never reads. Riot ids use the impossible tag line #EXAMPLE; summoner names are invented. poll null = the game closed. Replay each poll through normalizeLol(poll, prev, { nowMs: T0 + atMs }) (src/apps/sources/gamelink-lol.js).

frames.note: The loading screen: League of Legends.exe answers on 2999, no game data yet (HTTP 404).
Still loading: the same answer. Nothing new.
In game at 0:01: GameStart. Annie mid for ORDER (blue), level 1, 500 gold.
Half a second later: the same picture (the clock still reads 0:01). No event, the same state.
Minions spawn at 1:05 (phase pregame → live). Q learned.
Level 2: W learned.
Level 3.
First blood: we kill the enemy Zed (our Lee Sin assists). ChampionKill + FirstBlood.
The next read: the same history again. Deduped by EventID: no event, the same state.
The enemy Vi ganks: we die. respawnTimer 14.8 s (our HUD shows it).
Still dead, 8.8 s to go. Only our respawn countdown changes.
Back at the fountain.
Our Lee Sin takes all three Voidgrubs (HordeKill × 3). We are level 4 and bought boots + Luden's.
Level 6 (two levels since the last read): R learned. Abilities report levels only — no cooldowns.
Our team takes the Infernal drake (DragonType Fire); we assist.
We take the enemy outer mid tower (TurretKilled + FirstBrick). Level 7.
The enemy Vi takes the Rift Herald. The killer is named by game name only (older eventdata) — still resolved to CHAOS.
The enemy Darius takes our outer top tower: an objective that isn't ours (the owner is in the turret name).
The enemy Vi steals the Ocean drake (DragonType Water, Stolen True). We finished Zhonya's and Deathcap.
Level 13 before the fight at Baron.
Tibbers lands: we kill Darius and Vi. Double kill.
Triple kill (Zed).
Quadra kill (Caitlyn).
PENTAKILL (Thresh) and the ace: the whole enemy team is dead. Their respawn timers are never in the state.
Our Lee Sin smites Baron Nashor; we assist. Level 14. (No Baron respawn timer anywhere.)
We take the enemy mid inhibitor turret and the mid inhibitor (InhibKilled Barracks_T2_C1).
Both nexus towers fall, then the nexus: GameEnd Result Win. The final score is the scoreboard sum.
The victory screen: the same history again. Nothing new.
The game client closes: nothing listens on 2999 any more (the poller pushes null: "Waiting for a game").
